book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, bamii bamu lɛme fɛnɛ bo nyu gɛ bo to bo yu wuŋ wu kwe njɛ bo yɛŋ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo to bɛ bvuŋga bwe sɛŋ gɛ.”

content: Nfiɛɛnɛ yi Jiso kusɛ
Aju gɛ̀ fe bvusoo, Jiso jo Bita bɛ Jɛm mo Joŋ bɛ bo bɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ wumu le wù ndefe fɛwe le, bo nyu fo gɛh bo bo. Bo ja bo yɛŋ nfiɛɛnɛ ye kusɛ a bo jii,
njú ye baaŋ yi lale yi fede no taŋlo mu chugɛ fɛkuu fɛnɛ yi baaŋ.
Bo gɛ̀ ja bo yɛŋ Alaja bɛ Musɛ bo bunɛ fɛ bo le, bo jɛme bɛ Jiso.
Bita saa, wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh n'yɛyɛ wù baaŋ, fi joŋe no bee le fɛnɛ. Chinɛ bee jooŋ chúŋ yishɛde, yimi yo, yimi yi Musɛ, yimi yi Alaja.”
Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje njaŋ gɛ̀ koo bo baaŋ wu gɛ ka wu kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme gɛ.
Gɛh no wu jɛme noo, kimbɛ ja ki to ki baŋɛ bo, jɛ jɛmɛ a kimbɛ kiyu le lɛ, “Wunɛ le Mwa yaŋ, wu le fitele fiaŋ. Bɛŋ yûge nyu wu le.”
Bo ja bo jaŋe bo doo bo bijɛ bo gɛ ka bo yɛŋ bamii baa le gɛ, bo yɛŋ gɛh nyu Jiso le maa.
Bo gɛ̀ ja yi mbegɛ wɛɛ le bo doo bo boge, Jiso chiisɛ bo le lɛ keefɛ bo sɛ̂ɛŋ fiɛɛ fì bo be yɛŋ le njɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh bu wa yi kwe le sɛŋ gɛ.
Bo yu noo bo gɛɛ a bo shɛŋ, geenɛ bo tu bo ghaade gɛh lɛbolɛbo laa mbu wu yi kwe le wunɛ le nyu la lɛ.
Bo mo bo ja bo biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le nje la wù bamii ba duunyi banchi duu lɛ Alaja kɛme ki wu yâ wu to fɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka ge wu to?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ Alaja kɛme ki wu yâ wu to wu kɛnyɛ mwɛɛ munchii mu tu mu nyume gɛh no mu gɛ̀ bee. Geenɛ, le nje la wù ba le ba saŋ lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme ki wu gê wu yɛŋ baŋgɛ ba duude, bamii faŋ wu?
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ Alaja le wu to wa, bo ge fiɛɛ fì bo koŋe bɛ wu. Nyume gɛh no ba gɛ̀ saŋ kune wu.”

content: Jiso bvusɛ kiyo kì yiide yi mwa wumu le
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ boh bo to bo fɛsɛ fɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo bamu gɛ̀ bee fo, wu yɛŋ kinchvu ki bamii kì baaŋ ki kɛnɛ ki baŋ bo, bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo bo tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ bɛ bo.
Kimimia no kinchvu kichii yɛŋ Jiso le, bo njaŋɛ baaŋ, bo legɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛsɛ wu le.
Wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ kune la?”

content: Muh chvuu wu le a kinchvu ntɛnɛɛ lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, mbe nto bɛ mwa yaŋ fɛ wo le nje kiyo kimi le ye ye le, kì gee muh tu kinchifɛ.
Kiyo kiyu to kichufɛ wu ki noŋ fɛkuu, bifuu tu bi bude a wu mu wu ŋgeji bige, wu jade wu tɛɛnyi. Njɛmɛ lɛ booŋ buŋ ba ŋgoo bvusɛ kiyo kiyu, bo moŋ sɛŋ.”
Jiso yu noo, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “O oo! Kiŋgogɛ kì baaŋ lee gɛ fitele yi Nyo le kinɛ gɛ! Nlé nyû bɛ bɛŋ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ mbû nɛɛ? Nlé ŋkâaŋ shɛ́ŋ bɛ bɛŋ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ mbû nɛɛ? Bɛŋ to bɛ mwa wuyu fɛnɛ bɛŋ nya mɛne.”

content: Bo mo bo jo mwa wuyu bo tu bo too bɛ wu fɛ Jiso le. No kiyo kiyu yɛŋ Jiso le, ki mo ki chûfɛ mwa wuyu kimimia wu gwe fɛkuu wu tu wu biiŋse fo, bifuu bude amu.
Jiso biih chiji mwa wuyu le lɛ,

content.text: “Fiɛɛ finɛ gɛ̀ kɛ sege la?”

content: wu chvuu lɛ, “Fi gɛ̀ kɛ wu, wu baaŋ shige.
Kiyo kiyu le ki noŋ wa wù kiŋgane le kiŋgane le fɛ ŋgu le mo a joo le ki goone ki ki yuuyɛ lo wu. Nɛ wo taŋlo wo ge fiɛɛ, kii wo, wo koo gɛh lo yii fɛ bee le, wo fih bee.”
Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Lɛ laa ntaŋlo ŋge fiɛɛ la? Nyo taŋlo wu ge fiɛɛ fichii fɛ muh wù le wu leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le.”

content: Kimimia chiji mwa wuyu mo wu jaŋ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Nle nleesɛ fitele yi Nyo le. Gêe lɛ ŋka nleesɛ nfe lo noo.”
Jiso doo wu yɛŋ kinchvu ki bamii le ki lege ki too ki taashi fɛ wù gɛ̀ bee fo, wu waŋ kiyo kì yiide kiyu wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Wo, kiyo kì yiide kinɛ kì gee mwa wunɛ jɛme gɛ, wu yuge gɛ tɛ mwɛɛ gɛ, njɛme wo le, bû yi mwa wunɛ le, wo gɛɛŋ lo! Keefɛ wo ka wo lêe ye ye le gɛ!”

content: Kiyo kiyu jaŋ fɛwɛɛwe, ki ka kichufɛ mwa wuyu, ki noŋ wu a je yì befe le, ki mo ki bû ye ye le. Wu tu wu gime fɛkuu njɛ kiŋkwe ki muh. Bamii ba duude yɛŋ noo, bo tu bo duu lɛ, “Wu le wu kwe wa.”
Jiso jijɛ wu yi kibo le wu chiaasɛ wu, wu lɛɛŋ we.
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ bo lee yeh, bo biih wu le ajiŋ ajiŋ lɛ, “Le nje la wù bee be moŋ sɛŋ ki be bvusɛ nchɛndaa wu debele wɛɛ?”
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fiɛɛ fì taŋlo fi bvusɛ kfuu chi wunɛ nchɛndaa le gɛh buunɛ maa. Gɛ taŋlo fiɛɛ fimi yeye bvusɛ gɛ.”

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ kune kfuu chi kwe yì wu lé wu gê wu kwe
Bo ja fo bo fe je yi Galalee le, Jiso goone gɛ lɛ muh kɛɛ gɛ,
nje wu gɛ̀ jiɛnyi wu yɛyi booŋ be ba ŋgoo. Wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le ba nyu ba nya wu chiaaŋ yi bamii le ba yuuyɛ wu. Nɛ bo doo bo yuuyɛ wu noo, ge aju atade, wu bu yi kwe le.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme gɛ, geenɛ, bo tu bo faane ki bo biih.
Muh wù baaŋ le yɛɛŋ?
Bo gɛɛŋ bo bu kafanahom, bo gɛ̀ doo bo lee yeh, Jiso biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ be tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ a je kune la?”

content: Bo mɛ gɛh jwe wuchile, nje bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi a je bo tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ lɛbolɛbo lɛ, laa muh wù baaŋ le yɛɛŋ la.
Jiso shii fɛkuu, wu tɛɛŋ bo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ muh goone ki wu nyûme muh wù fwe, tu wu kɛme ki wu jô kikwɛɛ ke lɛ wu le kijimɛ mo muh wù lɛne fɛ bamii le bachii.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu jo mwa wù shige wu leesɛ a bo antɛnɛɛ, wu kaasɛ wu jo wù kɛme abo, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ muh fi mwa njɛ wunɛ a jee chaŋ le, tu wu fi nyume mɛ. Muh fii mɛ, tu gɛ wu fii nyume mɛ gɛ, tu wu fii tɛ nyu muh wu tuŋ mɛ.”

content: Muh nɛ baaŋ baa gɛ jiŋ wo le gɛ tu wu toone lo wo
Joŋ jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh n'yɛyɛ, bee chi be yɛŋ muh mu le wu tɛŋe jee chuŋ fɛ wu bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele yi bamii le, be faŋ, nje gɛ wu nyu muh ŋgoo yese besabɛŋ le gɛ.”
Geenɛ Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ chîde kfuu chi wɛɛ muh gɛ. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh gee kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ wu tɛŋe jee chaŋ, tu gɛ taŋlo wu ka wu jɛme fiɛɛ fì befe kune mɛ gɛ.
Nɛ muh baaŋ baa gɛ̀ jiŋ besabɛŋ le gɛ, tu wu toone besabɛŋ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh nya gɛh nyu fiŋkoo fi joo bɛŋ le nje ba tɛŋe bɛŋ lɛ bamii ba Kletu, tu gɛ wu nyu wu to wu fu maajɛ we gɛ.”

content: Mwɛɛ mù taŋlo mu ge bamii gee bimbefɛ

content.text: “Kɛnɛ nyume yɛɛŋ wù ge booŋ ba shige banɛ bò lese fitele ye yaŋ le ki bo ge kimbefɛ, fi joŋe fɛ wu wɛɛ muh le lɛ ba shɛŋshɛ kibwee ki jɛnɛ a kindoŋ ke le, ba tooŋsɛ wu a joo yì baaŋ le.

Fi ka nyume lɛ, kibo kuŋ gêe wo gee kimbefɛ, wo suunɛ kibo kiyu. Fi joŋe lɛ wo lee kinche kì kage gɛ le bɛ kibo kiŋkfunɛ, fede ki wo kɛ̂me chiaaŋ yichii wo gɛɛŋ ŋgu wù baaŋ le wù fiee segechii wu jime gɛ.
Nɛ kikaa kuŋ gêe wo gee kimbefɛ, wo suunɛ kikaa kiyu. Fi joŋe lɛ wo lee kinche kì kage gɛ le wo nyu ntɛŋlaase, fede ki wo kɛ̂me bikaa bichii ba noŋ wo ŋgu wù baaŋ le.
Nɛ jise chuŋ gêe wo gee kimbefɛ, wo bvusɛ jise chiyu wo noŋ. Fi joŋe lɛ wo lee bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le bɛ jise chimimia, fede ki wo kɛ̂me ajii achii, ba noŋ wo ŋgu wù baaŋ le.
Kijusɛ kinɛ le fɛ baŋgvule jii bamii fo bo kwee gɛ, ŋgu jime gɛ fo gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ ŋgu le wu kuŋ muh wuchii le gɛh njɛ no ba to ba yefɛ fiɛɛ bɛ ŋka.
Ŋka le fiɛɛ fì joŋe, geenɛ sege yi chii, wo ge nɛɛ fɛ yi ka yi kaasɛ yi jɛŋɛ? Bɛŋ nyûme njɛ ŋka yì jɛŋɛ, muh bɛ muh nyûme yi nyiɛgee le.”

footnotes.text: -44 Baŋwa ba kege bamu le ba bisɛ fɛnɛ bo ka bo bisɛ tɛ ajiŋ a 46 lɛ, “kijusɛ kinɛ le fɛ baŋgvule jii bamii fo bo kwee gɛ, ŋgu jime gɛ fo gɛ.”
